reference_policy: reference/reference-0.* is the ORIGINAL public reference image, not a generated reconstruction. Compare directly with candidate/main.png. Alternate view only supports shape interpretation.
focus: Layer foreground shelves, central display route and deep bright arch; clutter must have volume and leave the reference route readable. Warm weathered brick and wood, dark shelving and patterned red rug in mixed warm/rear light; paintings and labels may be simplified.

anchors.0: Absent, wholly wrong, or no visible evidence of the required result; no credit.
anchors.1: Weak resemblance/fulfilment (about one quarter); major omissions or pervasive defects.
anchors.2: Partial (about half); recognizable intent but material errors in key requirements or visual quality.
anchors.3: Mostly correct (about three quarters); concrete remaining discrepancies prevent excellent credit.
anchors.4: Excellent: all important visible requirements satisfied, coherent and polished, no material discrepancy. Requires explicit positive evidence, not merely lack of reported faults.

targets.label: 拱门
targets.review_note: 机器参考图标注，尚未人工校准。框住中央砖拱内的整个通道开口，包括顶部暗处，不含外围砖砌拱圈。左下部分被落地钟遮挡，右下边缘被小家具遮挡；仅依据可见开口确定范围。

targets.label: 货架
targets.review_note: 机器参考图标注，尚未人工校准。每座货架按完整可见家具计一次，包含立柱、顶框及暗色部分。依次为左侧贴边货架、左中独立陈列架、后方拱顶木质陈列柜、右后方金属架及右前景大货架。拱顶陈列柜按具有开放层板的货架计入，其下部被木桶和杂物遮挡，边界略有不确定。两侧前景货架被画面裁切；镜中架子不另计。

targets.label: 吊灯
targets.review_note: 机器参考图标注，尚未人工校准。计入三盏直接可见吊灯，框含可辨认的吊线、灯罩及暗色灯架。依次为拱门内小吊灯、中右白色吊灯及上方大白色吊灯；细吊线的起点略有不确定。左侧镜面中的枝形吊灯是反射，不另计实例。

localization.detector_revision_note: Explicit mean token scores over frozen phrases with class/context competition. Single scale; larger detector and two-scale alternatives were rejected after reference-only review.
localization.public_scope: Reference boxes cover visible image extents, not inferred hidden geometry. Only the listed key objects enter localization; other scene content remains in the appearance component. Archway is the whole central arch-and-opening envelope. Shelves are five open display units, including clipped foreground units and distant visible units; clocks, closed cabinets and isolated posts are excluded. These classes await detector calibration.

review_ledger.instance_convention: Tight visible extent; no hallucinated occluded parts; partial objects are explicitly recorded.
